### Questions for you (2)

- [`webcam-relay.test.ts:49`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/webcam-relay.test.ts#L49) · direction — The design depends on two things the code and tests cannot show: that mediabunny repeats the last frame when given an explicit frameRate and no frames arrive, and that a hidden-then-shown bubble window stays excluded from the running capture. The ADR marks the second unverified and "pending owner QA". A person must decide whether to ship on that basis or gate on a spike result.
- [`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:658`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts#L658) · open question — Webcam relay track between the camera and the encoder: Does mediabunny ^1.61.4's `MediaStreamVideoTrackSource` accept and honour a third `{ frameRate }` argument? Files that would answer it: `node_modules/mediabunny (not installed in this checkout)`.

### Risk facts

- `concurrency` · [`recorder-store.ts:939`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts#L939) — The camera-on open is queued behind other live toggles but the camera-off is applied immediately, so a late on can reopen the camera after an off.
- `public-contract` · [`recorder-store.ts:1109`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts#L1109) — The finalize metadata now carries an optional `gaps` field in the webcam sidecar that the editor and export read.
- `concurrency` · [`recording-hub.ts:309`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts#L309) — The bubble stays out of the running screen capture only if the OS keeps a hidden-then-shown window excluded, which the PR says was not verified.
- `public-contract` · [`webcam-track.ts:72`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts#L72) — The sidecar's `webcam` field gains an optional `gaps` array that the recorder sends at finalize and the editor reads. Older readers ignore it, and old sidecars lack it.

<details><summary>What the change connects to (7 closed, 1 open)</summary>

Questions the reviewer answered about what this change does to the running product. The engine checked that the cited lines exist, not that the answers are true.

**Open: the reviewer could not close these**

- Webcam relay track between the camera and the encoder (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:658`) — Does mediabunny ^1.61.4's `MediaStreamVideoTrackSource` accept and honour a third `{ frameRate }` argument? Files that would answer it: `node_modules/mediabunny (not installed in this checkout)`.

**Closed, with the lines they rest on**

- Camera turned off/on mid-take: park the bubble window instead of destroying it (`apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:299`) — The bubble disappears and returns in the same place without being burned into the screen recording. `placedBounds()` keeps the recorded bubble position for a take that ends with the camera off. If it fails: Hub and renderer can disagree for a moment. `recordingStart` sets `activity.active` (l.757) before `engine.begin()` has set `webcamStarted`, so an off in that window parks the window while the engine… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:299-335`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:456-460`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:491-499`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:757`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/camera-bubble-window.ts:262-282`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:420-428`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:730`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:770`.
- turnWebcamOn: reopen the camera and feed the relay, serialized on the forwarder queue (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:779`) — Within about 6 s of the toggle the face is back in the file, or the file ends and the bubble falls back into the screen capture. The user is told after the take. If it fails: Mic, system-audio and noise changes sit behind a pending on in the same queue for up to about 6 s. The off branch is not queued, so a queued on can open the camera after the user has turned it off (s… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:779-819`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:286`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:1102-1145`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:924-953`.
- Bubble preview follows the Camera toggle (`useCameraOn`) (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/camera-bubble/camera-bubble.tsx:44`) — The in-use light goes off while the window is parked. The preview reopens when the camera returns, and the window is shown before the stream, so the bubble can be blank for a moment. If it fails: If `getRecordingSettings` rejects, the `.catch` leaves it at true (camera on), which is the safe default for a window that only exists while the camera is on. Outside a take main destroys the window… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/camera-bubble/camera-bubble.tsx:44-61`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/camera-bubble/camera-bubble.tsx:143-144`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/hooks/use-camera-preview.ts:60-110`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/main/recording/recording-hub.ts:285-291`.
- Camera-off gaps recorded in the store and sent with finalize; seeded as hidden segments in the editor (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:924`) — The webcam lane shows a striped hidden segment where the camera was off, and export leaves the face out there. If it fails: A stop while a reopen is in flight closes the gap at the take end, which is fine. A reopen failure that resolves after stop is not reflected in `webcamUnavailable`, which is read synchronously at l.1… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:924-953`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:1002-1018`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:1106-1110`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/webcam-gaps.ts:10-30`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/scene.ts:140`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/scene.ts:151-154`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-model.ts:135-158`.
- Camera turned off/on mid-take: engine releases the camera, keeps the webcam file on the clock, and reopens into the same file via the relay (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.test.tsx:1602`) — The webcam file keeps running with its last frame held. The sidecar gets `webcam.gaps`, and the editor shows each gap as a hidden segment. If it fails: A reopen that fails, times out or sends no frame ends the file (endWebcam), reports `unavailable`, and the store shows the post-take toast (recorder-store.ts:946-951, 1018, 1069). A toggle that comes… Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:769-819`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.ts:741-754`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-store.ts:924-953`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/recording/recorder-engine.test.tsx:1706-1757`.
- Renderer-supplied `webcam.gaps` crosses finalize IPC and is sanitized before it lands in the sidecar (`apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts:131`) — Gaps reach the editor through seedWebcamScene, which stretches any gap shorter than 1 s. If it fails: A malformed entry is dropped silently. That is acceptable, since the worst case is a face shown over a held frame. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts:131-154`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.ts:184-185`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/shared/webcam-track.test.ts:172-203`.
- Gaps are seeded as hidden webcam segments in the editor and in Share (`apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-model.test.ts:94`) — The editor lane stripes each gap, and exports hide the face there. Share's reuse of an earlier export breaks for takes with gaps (see the finding on this file). If it fails: Silent: Share re-encodes instead of reusing an existing export. Evidence: `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/webcam/webcam-model.ts:135-158`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/export/export-reuse.ts:81-85`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/library/components/share-recording.tsx:126-130`, `apps/kaipu-record/src/renderer/src/features/video-editor/scene.ts:153`.

</details>

<details><summary>What the reviewer checked</summary>

**Batch 1 of 2.** I found one bug worth fixing before merge. In `recorder-store.ts`, camera-off runs immediately but camera-on goes through the queue. A fast on, off, on, off with a slow camera can reopen the camera after the user turned it off, leaving the light on and real face frames in a span recorded as a gap. The comment at l.938 says the opposite happens. The fix is an early return when `webcamOn` is false at the top of the queued closure. Two smaller points: one hub test is named for the reset path but only exercises abort, and I could not confirm that mediabunny accepts the new third constructor argument (`{ frameRate }`), because it isn't installed here and the engine tests mock it. The park/destroy logic in the hub and bubble window, the gap bookkeeping and the relay lifecycle are consistent. The one race I checked, an off between `recordingStart` and `begin()`, falls back to the legacy path. The hub and the renderer agree on that fallback. I read the code only and ran nothing.

**Batch 2 of 2.** I read all nine files of this part and cross-checked the tests against the engine, store, relay, gap log and webcam model. The new tests match the code they cover. I found two problems. Gap segments get random UUID ids, so Share's \"whole\" fingerprint changes on every open for a take with gaps, and Share never reuses an earlier export for those takes. The spec also still describes the old \"turned off ends the file\" rule in two places, at lines 286 and 329. I did not run any tests. The docs list two behaviours as unverified: whether mediabunny repeats the last frame given an explicit frameRate, and whether a hidden-then-shown bubble stays excluded from capture.

</details>

<details><summary>Details of findings with no thread (1)</summary>

**Spec sections 2 and 3.2 still describe the pre-relay rule for a camera turned off mid-take (confidence medium)** ([`2026-10-30-webcam-track-design.md:286`](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-wachi-v3/blob/3ec7a138c3a878b38284fd13c801ab7226a34abb/apps/documentation/src/content/docs/specs/2026-10-30-webcam-track-design.md#L286))

Decision 7 is revised, but line 286 still says "after its last frame (turned off) the layer is not drawn". With the relay the file keeps running and holds its last frame, and the editor hides the face through `gaps` instead. Line 329 lists "turned off" among the cases that leave the bubble in the screen capture. That now holds only with no relay, during the countdown, or when the reopen fails. Add a pointer to decision 7 and ADR 0032 decision 6 at both places so the page does not contradict itself.

</details>

<sub>Answer a finding in its thread: `Verdict: correct` or `Verdict: wrong`, and why.</sub>
